title: Technology Sector Update for 12/14/2018: GOOG, SHOP, INFY, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -1.82%
AAPL: -2.43%
IBM: -0.75%
CSCO: -3.25%
GOOG: -1.13%
Technology stocks were declining this afternoon, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing 1.9% in value. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was down 0.6%.
Moving stocks include:
(-) Alphabet ( GOOG ) was down more than 1%. The company launched a shopping aggregator service in India to allow users the ability to filter through offers and review prices from multiple retailers.
In other sector news:
(-) Shopify ( SHOP ) was down 11% after it launched an offering of 2.6 million Class A subordinate voting shares. It expects to use the net proceeds to strengthen its balance sheet, providing flexibility to fund its growth strategies.
(+) Infosys ( INFY ) was recently trading higher after saying it established a joint venture with Hitachi Ltd., Panasonic Corp. and Pasona Inc. as it seeks to expand its footprint in Japan.
